ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $2.74 Ryde voucher (mileage unit refund for the unexempted detour segment) to the rider for trip B-0049
ruling.reasoning:
RD-1 is satisfied: the record contains one off-route segment, F3 (09:47–09:53, 3.83 km driven where the optimal route covers 1.89 km, adding 1.94 km and straying up to 777 m), and no percentage or kilometre threshold exists under RD-1, so any unexplained deviation breaches the shortest-and-most-direct obligation [F1][F3][RD-1].

RD-4 does not exempt that segment. The trace marks RD-4(a) as failed with no qualifying incident, and F12 confirms no traffic incident was recorded near the route; the only speed records are band 4 (30–39 km/h) on Ayer Rajah Expressway and Kent Ridge Road (F10, F11), which are above the band 1–2 range RD-4(b) contemplates, and RD-4(b) is corroborative only and cannot exempt a segment on its own. The driver's statement that "I followed my GPS; it rerouted me" (F9) is a post-hoc assertion that cannot outweigh the system records [F9][F10][F11][F12][RD-4].

RD-5 gives no consent for the segment. Consent must be a rider message sent before the segment started; the chat record is complete and every message is timestamped (F8), but its only message is the rider's 09:35 pickup-kerb note (F7), which is a pickup arrangement and says nothing about any route. The driver's verbal/GPS claim in F9 is not rider consent (G11). With a complete chat record and no rider agreement before the 09:47 segment, the segment counts [F7][F8][F9][RD-5].

RD-3 does not apply: no rider-named stop appears in the record and no stop was measured within the segment (F7, F3), so there is nothing to exempt under RD-3(a) [F7][F3][RD-3].

This is a metered RydeTAXI trip, so RD-2 applies to the mileage unit only. The per-km rate is the fare record's distance fare ÷ distance km: $18.50 ÷ 13.12 km = $1.4101/km; 1.94 km (the unexempted segment's extra_km, F3) × $1.4101/km = $2.7356 → $2.74. The difference between the billed excess of 2.44 km (F4: 2.44 × $1.4101 = $3.44) and the segment sum is corridor round-trip/map-matching mileage that RD-2 expressly does not refund, so the refund is $2.74, not $3.44, and nothing of the $29.11 metered total is otherwise disturbed [F3][F4][F6][RD-2].

No account flag: RD-6 requires route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1, and F15 records route: 0, so this case cannot make a "repeated" route violation and the trace marks RD-6 failed [F15][RD-6].

segment_findings.reason: The chat record is complete and every message timestamped (F8), and its only message is the rider's 09:35 pickup-kerb note (F7), which concerns the pickup point and not the route; no rider message before 09:47 agrees to any route change, and the driver's post-trip statement (F9) is not consent (G11). The 1.94 km extra_km therefore counts under RD-5 and is refundable under RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: The +2.4 km / +23% figure is a whole-trip total (F1), not a segment excess; RD-2 refunds only the extra_km of unexempted segments, so the headline percentage adds nothing to the amount [F1][F3][RD-2].
RD-6 requires route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1; F15 records route: 0, so no repeated route violation and no flag_account basis exists [F15][RD-6].
Correct that corridor/matching mileage is not refundable under RD-2, but the ~0.5 km at issue does not reduce the segment's own extra_km, which remains refundable [F1][F3][F4][RD-2].

Band 4 (30–39 km/h) on Ayer Rajah Expressway and Kent Ridge Road is not band 1–2 and no incident was recorded, so RD-4(a) is not met and RD-4(b) is corroborative only; the segment is not exempted [F10][F11][F12][F9][RD-4].

The refund is limited to the unexempted segment's extra_km, not the billed 2.44 km (F4); 1.94 km × $1.4101/km = $2.74 under RD-2, and the $3.44 framing is not the sum of unexempted segments [F3][F4][RD-2].
The absence of a driver-solicited change does not exempt the segment; RD-5 requires the rider's own message before the segment, and none exists here, so the segment counts [F7][F8][F3][RD-5].
The driver's trip count and rating are profile facts that cannot decide the case on their own, and RD-6 is not triggered in any event since route: 0 in F15 [F15][RD-6].
